text:
jason_w: Heads-up: sinew-13B-int4 hitting OOMs on prod path when batch_size >= 3 + long contexts (~1200 tokens). Opening thread to track and coordinate fixes.

 tanya_s: Which pool/hosts? Can you repro locally?

 jason_w: Reproduced on ded-sinew-13b pool (p3dn-24gb). Local repro on a dev p3dn as well. Logs snippet: 
 ```
 ERROR: cuda memory alloc failed: 12.1 GiB requested, 11.6 GiB available
 model: sinew-13B-int4
 prompt_tokens: ~1300
 batch_size: 3
 kv_cache: growing per request
 ```

 priya_r: Sounds like memfrag + KV growth. What's the max_new_tokens default for this model? If it's 1024 that plus the prompt could push us over.

 jason_w: It was left at 1024 from onboarding notes. I agree that's risky for int4.

 alex_m: Short-term mitigation suggestions: set model default max_new_tokens=512, cap adaptive batching for this model to 2, and enable kv_trim_on_epoch/new_seq to reclaim entries. Also try compacting the allocator with memfix tool: `memfix --env=ded-sinew-13b --compact`.

 tanya_s: Can we also add a fallback policy to int8 when OOM occurs instead of failing? That'd buy us availability.

 jason_w: Good call. I'll push a canary with: batch_max=2, max_new_tokens=512, fallback=int8:on_oom. Will include kv_trim_on_new_seq=true.

 eng-ci-bot: CI job queued: quant-regen + eval suite for sinew-13B-int4 with updated defaults (tests: conv-bench, summarization-regression, hallucination-check). Job id: ci-20260320-77.

 priya_r: Important: before rolling broader, run quality evaluations. We saw small coherence regressions on other int4s with long contexts — track eval-id 20260320-sinew-quant and include per-prompt diffs.

 deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to ded-sinew-13b (3 instances) with config: {batch_max:2, max_new_tokens:512, fallback_policy:"int8-on-oom", kv_trim:true}.

 jason_w: Initial canary update: 2 hours in, 0 OOMs, steady-state latency +6% p50, token cost down ~18%. Continuing 24h soak.

 alex_m: If we still see frag after soak, enable allocator compaction on cadence and disable aggressive prefetch of KV for long prompts: prefetch=false for requests >512.

 tanya_s: :eyes: If this holds, update model onboarding checklist: default max_new_tokens <=512 for 13B-int4 variants, require fallback policy, and a memfrag smoke test. I'll draft the checklist changes.

 jason_w: Thanks — I'll paste the perf logs and CI eval links into the thread when the 24h run finishes.

 priya_r: Also add a note to run a targeted hallucination regression on the top 100 failing prompts if we see quality drift after fallback.

 alex_m: :thumbsup: Good plan.

 deploy-bot: Canary marked healthy after 24h. No OOM, metrics stable. Rolling rollout queued for low-traffic hosts.

 jason_w: Closing for now, leaving follow-ups: (1) onboarding checklist PR, (2) run full eval suite post-rollout, (3) memfix compaction job if frag returns.
